note: One entry per game. The card fields drive the /games/ gallery, the home page, the footer, the sitemap and llms.txt. A game with a `content` file also gets its own page at `slug`. `play` is the tool page that runs the game (its facts live in tools.json under the same id).

games.name: Doctrine
games.sizzle: Send your soldiers down the lanes and take their castle.
games.line: A lane battle between two castles. Every soldier is its own body on a navigation mesh, and every 30 seconds the battle pauses so you can choose what to send and how to order it. Play the computer, or another person online.
games.teaches: Each side's soldiers are items in one store, and the same choices in the same order always play out the same match, so a match can be checked by a short fingerprint at each pause.
games.powers: The soldiers are Pleroma stores from Phasor, the battle runs on a Tracer navigation mesh, and each step is an EvalApp pipeline.
games.phone: Laid out for a phone screen: one column, 44 px tap targets.
